Dear Odoo Team,

I am writing to apply for the Web Designer position at Odoo. With a strong foundation in web design and development, I am excited about the opportunity to build beautiful, functional websites and e-commerces for your clients.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and Astra, and I have hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and responsive design. I also have a portfolio of completed websites, including mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page site with a focus on SEO and user experience.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, and I am currently learning Dutch (B1). While I do not speak Spanish, German, or Italian, I am a quick learner and would be excited to develop language skills if needed.

I am particularly drawn to Odoo's collaborative culture and the opportunity to work on diverse projects. I am confident that my design and coding skills, combined with my problem-solving mindset, make me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Odoo Team,

I am excited to apply for the Web Designer position at Odoo. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design and development, I have the design sensibility and coding skills to create websites that are both beautiful and functional. I am particularly drawn to Odoo's emphasis on collaboration and the opportunity to work on diverse projects from start to finish.

In my current role at Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme. I have hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles, ensuring that every site I create is clean, maintainable, and visually consistent across devices. I also have a portfolio of completed websites, including mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page site for a Belgian youth chess champion. This project involved full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration, and I implemented structured data and technical SEO audits to improve visibility.

I am proficient in UI/UX design tools such as Canva and have experience with Adobe Suite basics. I am comfortable with versioning tools like Git and have a working knowledge of JavaScript. I am also familiar with SEO and web accessibility principles, which I apply to every project.

While I do not speak Spanish, German, or Italian, I am fluent in English and Turkish, and I am currently learning Dutch (B1). I am a quick learner and would be excited to develop language skills if needed.

I am impressed by Odoo's commitment to training and the flexible work environment. I am confident that my design and coding skills, combined with my problem-solving mindset, make me a strong fit for this role. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to your team and grow with Odoo.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
